excerpt: Project 8 Apparatus for Cyclotron Radiation Emission Spectroscopy with 83mKr and Tritium. We describe the Project 8 Phase II apparatus, used for the detection of the CRES signal from the conversion electrons of 83mKr and the first CRES measurement of the beta-decay spectrum of molecular tritium.
title: Project 8 Apparatus for Cyclotron Radiation Emission Spectroscopy with 83mKr and Tritium
